'''Lord Falconcrest''' is one of the leaders of the [[Syndicate]], a vicious group of brigands led by former lords of Alterac bent on regaining their old territory and taking revenge on their enemies. He is found in [[Stromgarde Keep]] in the [[Arathi Highlands]]. Falconcrest is rarely seen without his servant and bodyguard [[Otto]] by his side. Prince [[Galen Trollbane]] has placed a bounty on his head,<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|40+|Securing the Keep}}</ref> and he is thus currently marked for death by the [[Stromgarde Militia]] for his crimes.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|40+|Wanted! Otto and Falconcrest}}</ref> He also directs operations against [[Southshore]].<ref>[[Foreboding Plans]]</ref>
